data.raw_text:
[2:44PM] #Okota #Isolo #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic movement across the Okota and Isolo axis is generally smooth this evening. Cele inward towards Ago Roundabout is free-flowing, with the return journey equally good. The Cele Link Bridge inward to Ijesha, providing access to Ijesha Market, is clear in both directions. Similarly, the inner part of Nwachukwu Drive connecting to Cele is also good to go, inward and outward.

Along Ago Palace Way, movement towards  Apple Junction remains encouraging at this time. The Ibeh, Apata, and Transformer Junction corridors inward to Ilasa Service Lane are clear, with no obstruction in the return flow. The inner part of Ire Akari linking Osolo Road is also free in both directions.

Chemist inward towards Pako is moving smoothly, as is the return route. The Oke Afa stretch towards Lasutech Roundabout is also clear in both directions. Daleko Bridge inward towards Palm Avenue records no delay, with return movement equally free. Furthermore, traffic around Five Star and Iyana Isolo inward towards Ijesha Express—both on the main carriageway and service lane—is currently good to go, with no reported impediments for now.
Our men are present at important locations ensuring ease of traffic movement.

#FollowLASTMA
